content.text:
Quick update: I've finished scrolling the page. Here's how it went.

**Short version:** I didn't pick anything. There are 143 tracks and they all look the same. Every "דמי ניהול" is somewhere between 0.5% and 0.7%, and the S&P 500 tracks all show about 12–13% for 3 years. I'm leaning towards an "עוקב מדד S&P 500" track at a name I know, like אלטשולר שחם (0.54%) or מיטב, but I'm not sure enough to do it today. What stopped me: the very top, cheapest group (0.54%–0.57%) has no company name I could see. The first rows start straight under the column headings, so I don't know whose they are.

**How I went through it:**
- **Top of the page:** "כל המסלולים בכל החברות", with קופת גמל להשקעה already chosen and "143 מסלולים של 12 חברות". I read the orange box only far enough to see it was a notice and skipped it.
- **The category buttons:** I saw "עוקב מדד s&p 500 12" but didn't tap it.
- **The table:** I scrolled fast. My eyes went to the big returns. "מניות 24.04%" stuck in my head. Later I saw "עוקב מדדים - גמיש 26.39%" and "עוקב מדד מניות 25.86%". Then I figured out these are per year over 3 years, which is crazy high.
- **Company names:** I only noticed them in the grey header rows: מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, ילין לפידות, כלל, איילון. In some places the header fell between screens and I lost which company I was looking at.
- **What I skipped:** I hardly looked at screens 12 and 13. I only checked the bottom to see if there was a "best pick" or a summary. There isn't one, just a grey note and links.

**Words I didn't get:**
- "מט"ח" next to a percent (99%, 26%…), and those yellow and green circles
- "ההפקדות" with 0% next to "ההחיסכון"
- "גמיש", "אג"ח ממשלתי", "כספי (שקלי)", "קופה" with numbers like 15286
- "פחות מ־3 שנים" where the return should be: is that bad?

**What bothered me:**
- The fees are all tiny percentages, so I can't tell what I'd actually pay in shekels.
- Lots of rows say "עוד לא דווח" with an orange warning icon, which scared me off them.
- The table is endless and I nearly closed it around the fifth screen.
- Some companies are only "הזנקה"-sized names I've never heard of (מור, אנליסט, ילין).
